notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Idris.
description:
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Idris' ability.
Resolve the copy of Idris' ability, untapping it.
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Idris ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.
